description: Initialize Next.js app with Bun and TypeScript
steps: Scaffold Next.js (App Router) project using Bun as package manager and runtime
Enable TypeScript strict mode and configure @/* path alias to project root
Install core dependencies: better-auth, @tiptap/react, @tiptap/pm, @tiptap/starter-kit, nanoid, zod
Add .env.example with BETTER_AUTH_SECRET and BETTER_AUTH_URL
Add data/ directory to .gitignore
Verify bun dev starts and bun run build succeeds

description: Set up Tailwind CSS with typography plugin
steps: Install and configure Tailwind CSS with PostCSS
Install @tailwindcss/typography and enable it for prose styling
Import Tailwind in app/globals.css with a neutral base background
Verify a Tailwind utility class renders correctly on the home page
Create lib/db.ts using Bun's SQLite client pointing to data/app.db
Ensure data/ directory is created if missing
Implement getDb() returning a singleton connection
Enable foreign keys and WAL mode on connection
Implement typed helpers query<T>(sql, params?), get<T>(sql, params?), run(sql, params?)
Verify helpers execute a simple SELECT 1 query

description: Create SQLite schema init script with better-auth tables
steps: Create scripts/init-db.ts that runs idempotent CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements
Create user table with id, name, email (unique), emailVerified, image, timestamps
Create session table with userId foreign key, unique token, expiresAt, ipAddress, userAgent, timestamps
Create account table with userId foreign key, accountId, providerId, token fields, password, timestamps
Create verification table with identifier, value, expiresAt, timestamps
Add db:init script to package.json
Verify all tables exist with correct structure after running the script
Add notes table to init script: id, user_id, title, content_json, is_public, public_slug (unique), created_at, updated_at
Add foreign key user_id -> user(id)
Create idx_notes_user_id, idx_notes_public_slug, idx_notes_is_public indexes
Verify notes table and all three indexes exist
Create lib/auth.ts with betterAuth configuration
Configure SQLite database adapter using Bun SQLite (data/app.db)
Enable email/password (credential) authentication with minimum password length
Configure session expiration and cookie settings
Add Next.js cookies plugin for server action support
Export auth instance
Create app/api/auth/[...all]/route.ts
Export GET and POST handlers from better-auth's Next.js integration
Verify /api/auth/get-session responds without errors
Create lib/auth-client.ts using createAuthClient from better-auth/react
Export signIn, signUp, signOut and useSession helpers
Verify client imports compile in a client component
Create lib/session.ts with getSession() reading headers via auth.api.getSession
Add getCurrentUser() returning user or null
Add requireUser() that redirects to /login when unauthenticated (for pages)
Add API helper that returns 401 JSON response when unauthenticated
Mark module server-only
Create components/SignUpForm.tsx client component
Add name, email, password inputs with accessible labels
Add client-side validation (required name, email format, password length)
Integrate with auth client signUp.email method
Display error messages on failure and disable submit while pending
Redirect to /dashboard on success
Create components/LoginForm.tsx client component
Add email and password inputs with accessible labels
Add client-side validation (email format, required password)
Integrate with auth client signIn.email method
Display error messages on failure and disable submit while pending
Redirect to /dashboard on success
Create app/(auth)/login/page.tsx rendering LoginForm
Create app/(auth)/register/page.tsx rendering SignUpForm
Add links between login and register pages
Redirect already-authenticated users to /dashboard
Verify full sign up -> dashboard and login -> dashboard flows
Add Next.js proxy/middleware that checks the better-auth session cookie
Redirect unauthenticated requests for /dashboard and /notes/* to /login
Leave /, /login, /register, /p/* and /api/auth/* publicly accessible
Keep server-side requireUser() checks in protected pages as the authoritative check
Verify unauthenticated access to /dashboard redirects to /login

description: Build global layout header with auth state
steps: Update app/layout.tsx with header containing app name linking to /
Show Log in / Sign up links when unauthenticated
Show user name, Dashboard link and Log out button when authenticated
Create components/LogoutButton.tsx client component calling signOut and redirecting to /
Verify header updates correctly after login and logout

description: Create note types and read/create repository functions (lib/notes.ts)
steps: Create lib/notes.ts with Note type (id, userId, title, contentJson, isPublic, publicSlug, createdAt, updatedAt)
Add row mapper converting snake_case DB rows to Note (is_public integer -> boolean)
Implement createNote(userId, data) with default title 'Untitled note' and empty TipTap doc
Implement getNoteById(userId, noteId) filtered by user_id
Implement getNotesByUser(userId) ordered by updated_at desc
Verify functions with a quick script or test

description: Implement note update and delete repository functions
steps: Implement updateNote(userId, noteId, data) updating only provided fields
Auto-set updated_at to current timestamp on update
Return null when note not found or not owned by user
Implement deleteNote(userId, noteId) as hard delete scoped by user_id
Verify a user cannot update or delete another user's note
Implement setNotePublic(userId, noteId, isPublic)
Generate a 16+ char nanoid slug when enabling and no slug exists
Set is_public = 0 and public_slug = NULL when disabling
Implement getNoteByPublicSlug(slug) returning note only when is_public = 1
Verify disabled notes are not returned by slug lookup
Create app/api/notes/route.ts
Return 401 when unauthenticated
GET: return list of { id, title, isPublic, updatedAt } for current user (omit contentJson)
POST: validate body with zod (optional title, optional contentJson object)
POST: create note with defaults and return 201 with created note
Return 400 on invalid body and handle DB errors gracefully with 500
Create app/api/notes/[id]/route.ts
Return 401 when unauthenticated
GET: return full note with parsed contentJson, 404 if not found or not owned
PUT: validate body with zod, stringify contentJson, update note, return 200 or 404
DELETE: hard delete, return 204 on success or 404 if not found
Verify cross-user access returns 404
Create app/api/notes/[id]/share/route.ts
Return 401 when unauthenticated
Validate body { isPublic: boolean } with zod
Call setNotePublic and return { id, isPublic, publicSlug }
Return 404 if note not found or not owned
Create app/api/public-notes/[slug]/route.ts (no auth required)
Return only { title, contentJson } for public notes
Return 404 when slug not found or note is not public
Verify no owner or private data is leaked in the response
Create components/NoteEditor.tsx client component using useEditor and EditorContent
Configure StarterKit with heading levels 1-3, plus inline code and code block (avoid duplicate extension registration)
Accept initial content (TipTap JSON) and onChange callback props
Emit editor.getJSON() via onChange on every update
Set immediatelyRender: false to avoid SSR hydration mismatches
Style editor content with Tailwind prose classes
Create components/EditorToolbar.tsx receiving the editor instance
Add buttons: Bold, Italic, H1, H2, H3, Paragraph, Bullet list, Inline code, Code block, Horizontal rule
Each button calls editor.chain().focus().<command>().run()
Show active state for active marks/nodes (aria-pressed)
Ensure buttons are keyboard accessible with labels
Integrate toolbar into NoteEditor
Create components/NoteList.tsx accepting notes: { id, title, updatedAt, isPublic }[]
Render each note as a link to /notes/[id]
Show title, formatted last updated time and shared badge
Render empty state when no notes exist
Create app/dashboard/page.tsx as server component
Require authenticated user on server (requireUser)
Fetch notes via getNotesByUser and render NoteList
Add 'Create note' button that POSTs /api/notes (or server action) and navigates to /notes/[id]
Verify new note appears in list with default title
Create app/notes/[id]/page.tsx server component requiring auth
Load note via getNoteById and call notFound() if missing or not owned
Render client wrapper with title input and NoteEditor using parsed contentJson
Implement debounced autosave via PUT /api/notes/[id] for title and content
Show saving / saved / error status indicator
Verify edits persist after page reload
Create components/ShareToggle.tsx client component with accessible switch/checkbox
Call POST /api/notes/[id]/share on toggle
Show public URL (/p/{slug}) with copy button when enabled
Hide URL when disabled and handle errors with rollback of toggle state
Add ShareToggle to note editor page
Create components/DeleteNoteButton.tsx client component
Ask for confirmation before deleting
Call DELETE /api/notes/[id] and redirect to /dashboard on success
Display error message on failure
Add DeleteNoteButton to note editor page
Create components/PublicNoteViewer.tsx client component
Render TipTap content read-only using the same extensions with editable: false
Apply prose styling for formatted output
Do not use dangerouslySetInnerHTML
Create app/p/[slug]/page.tsx server component (no auth required)
Load note via getNoteByPublicSlug and call notFound() when missing or not public
Render title and PublicNoteViewer
Show no owner information or user-specific navigation for anonymous viewers
Verify page returns 404 after sharing is disabled
Update app/page.tsx with short app description
Add Log in / Sign up CTAs for anonymous users
Show 'Go to dashboard' CTA for authenticated users

description: Add loading states, error handling and not-found pages
steps: Add loading.tsx for dashboard and note editor routes
Add error.tsx boundaries for dashboard and notes routes
Add not-found.tsx with 'Note not found' message
Add toast or inline feedback for save, share and delete actions
Ensure DB errors are caught and return graceful messages
Verify every note query in authenticated context filters by user_id
Verify all /api/notes endpoints return 401 when unauthenticated
Verify public endpoints/pages expose only title and content
Verify public slugs are 16+ random characters
Run full flow: sign up, create, edit, share, view publicly, unshare, delete, log out
Verify bun run lint and bun run build pass
